title: Validation of a deep neural network workflow for fully automated dicentric chromosome analysis in biological dosimetry
summary: A deep neural network workflow for dicentric chromosome detection was validated with threshold optimisation, calibration curves and independent testing in biological dosimetry, with the network doing the scoring. The full text states the cohort, data, comparison and evaluation behind this claim. Generalizability beyond the reported population, data and protocol was not established.
